decisions.reason: As a distant niche offer with only limited website visibility, submarine interior lighting appears less central to the firm’s announced LED path and easier to withdraw despite some sunk development effort.

The medical examination light builds on the firm’s existing lighting capabilities and was given a dedicated page, so management is likely to justify and continue the launch rather than retreat quickly.
Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit the firm’s industrial customer base, involve a multi-model product line and visible commitment, which strongly favors persistence.
The designer task light is close to the established offer and its public relaunch of a popular model signals prior commitment that management is likely to defend for longer.
